# chrome_all

Chrome-board residuals [px] of the geometric start and the radiometric refinement (variant motion), the change in percent (negative: an improvement), on the dots both models score; "all": the refinement on every dot it scores; photographs and dots as start / refined; coverage: the percent of the registered dots each scores, start / refined.
